title: smpwhitelister
description: This Plugin Adds Whitelisting Through discord through the command !whitelist <IGN> Links your Discord account to a MC username and whitelists them. One account per Discord user.
body:
**SMPWhitelist**

by Arcana Studios

**What is SMPWhitelist?**

SMPWhitelist bridges your Discord server and Minecraft whitelist — letting players register themselves directly from a Discord channel without any admin involvement. No commands, no tickets, no back-and-forth.

**Features**

Self-service whitelisting — Players run !whitelist <IGN> in your designated Discord channel and get added instantly
Self-service removal — Players can unlink their account anytime with !whitelistclear
One account per user — Each Discord account can only link one Minecraft username
Admin controls — Admins can look up, remove, or manage any entry via Discord or in-game commands
Offline mode support — Works on both online-mode and offline-mode servers
Clean channels — Command messages are automatically deleted after processing


**Discord Commands**

CommandWhoDescription!whitelist <IGN>EveryoneLink your Minecraft account!whitelistclearEveryoneRemove your own whitelist entry!whitelistclear <@user>AdminsRemove another user's entry!whitelistcheck <@user/IGN>AdminsLook up a whitelist entry

**In-Game Commands**

All require the discordwhitelist.admin permission (op by default).
CommandDescription/dwl statusView bot status and config info/dwl listList all Discord → Minecraft entries/dwl remove <IGN/DiscordID>Remove a whitelist entry/dwl reloadReload config and restart the bot

**Setup**

Create a bot at discord.com/developers
Drop the plugin .jar into your /plugins folder
Add your bot token and channel ID to config.yml
Optionally set an admin-role-id to restrict admin commands
Restart your server — the bot will announce itself in your channel
